name: Joseph Lebeau
want: bring the company safely through to Fort Bridger, get paid, and go home to his mother's people on the Wind River
secret: His Shoshone cousins sent word that diggers are on their land, and he means to lead no wagons there.
voice: Quiet, exact; switches between English, French and Shoshone mid-sentence when he is tired.
description: The son of an Eastern Shoshone mother and a French-Canadian trapper, raised between Fort Bridger and the Wind River valley. He has guided companies up the Platte for six summers and knows every ford and spring.
appearance: Lean and weathered, braided hair under a wide hat, a Hudson's Bay coat, a Spencer carbine always within reach.
